name: Seated Cable Row

instructions.description: Sit with feet supported and grasp the cable handle.
Begin tall with arms extended and shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handle toward the lower ribs while drawing the elbows back.
Return the handle slowly without collapsing the trunk.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Seated Cable Row — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Seated Cable Row — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Avoid leaning far backward to complete the pull.
